mcat_description.short: Prefabricated Structures are factory-manufactured building systems — including PEB industrial sheds, modular rooms, portable cabins, and large-span halls — assembled on-site from pre-engineered steel frames, sandwich panels, and cladding components. They are sold as complete turnkey structures or as supply-and-erect packages, primarily in steel, PUF/EPS sandwich panels, and PPGI sheet materials.
mcat_description.long: Prefabricated Structures in the Indian B2B market encompass a wide range of factory-built, site-assembled building solutions designed for industrial, commercial, institutional, and residential applications. The dominant commercial form is the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) — a steel-framed structure with insulated sandwich panel walls and roofing, used for warehouses, factory sheds, cold storages, and large-span commercial halls. Secondary product types include portable cabins (porta cabins), modular rooms, labour colonies, container homes, and prefab houses, all sharing the core principle of off-site fabrication and rapid on-site assembly. Relevant BIS standards include IS 13831 (Code of Practice for Prefabricated Buildings), IS 15916 (Prefabricated Concrete), IS 15917 (Mixed/Composite Construction), and IS 800 (General Construction in Steel), with structural design governed by IS 875 (design loads) and IS 1893 (seismic design). Buyers evaluate structural span, insulation grade, panel type, load capacity, and compliance with IS codes as primary decision criteria.

market_context: In the Indian market, 'Prefabricated Structures' is a broad category commercially dominated by Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — steel-framed, panel-clad industrial and commercial structures used for warehouses, factory sheds, cold storages, and large-span halls. Key manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Interarch, Metal Tree, Pressmach, and BNAL Prefabs, with manufacturing hubs in NCR, Pune, and Hyderabad. The secondary segment comprises portable cabins (porta cabins), modular rooms, container homes, and prefab houses, which are sold as discrete units for site offices, labour accommodation, and residential use. Relevant BIS standards include IS 13831 (Code of Practice for Prefabricated Buildings), IS 15916 (Prefabricated Concrete), IS 15917 (Mixed/Composite Construction), and IS 800 (Steel Construction); structural design is governed by IS 875 (design loads) and IS 1893 (seismic design). Materials used span mild steel (MS), FRP, PUF/EPS insulated sandwich panels, PPGI sheets, rock wool, and glass wool insulation. Buyers in this MCAT are predominantly industrial and commercial — factory owners, warehouse operators, infrastructure project managers, and institutional procurement teams — who evaluate structural span, insulation grade, IS code compliance, and erection speed as primary decision criteria. The LGSF (Light Gauge Steel Frame) sub-segment is an emerging residential and institutional variant, with keyword signals ('lgsf sample flats manufacturers in jaipur') confirming early-stage buyer awareness in India.
